# GitHub Discussions Category Proposal

Suggested discussion categories for the OpenMeshAI repository.

## Announcements

Maintainer updates, release notes, roadmap changes, and project direction.

## Ideas

Product ideas, architecture proposals, mesh concepts, provider integrations, and future platform features.

## Q&A

Setup help, usage questions, contributor questions, and debugging support that is not yet a confirmed bug.

## Show And Tell

Screenshots, local demos, external agent experiments, UI mockups, and community prototypes.

## Architecture

Deeper design discussion for provider abstraction, mesh schema, trace model, runtime layer, CLI, SDK, and federation.

## Good First Issues

Discussion and coordination for beginner-friendly contributions.

## Integrations

Provider, tool, runtime, SDK, external agent, and CLI integration topics.

## Research

Links and discussion about agent observability, multi-agent systems, traces, governance, reputation, and AI infrastructure.
